    StartersJack's RV ham croquetasCreamy ham croquetas crumbed and fried, with lime garlic mayoHow to make it60g butter120g plain flour500ml full cream milk200g leg ham, finely chopped1 pinch ground nutmeg2 eggs, beaten120g breadcrumbs1 L vegetable oil, for frying150g mayonnaise1 garlic clove, crushed1 limeMelt the butter, stir in some of the flour for a couple of minutes, then slowly whisk in the milk until very thick.Stir in the ham, nutmeg and pepper. Spread on a tray, cover and chill.Shape into small logs, roll in the remaining flour, dip in egg and coat in breadcrumbs.Fry in the vegetable oil at 180°C until golden, working in batches.Mix the mayonnaise with the garlic and a squeeze of lime juice and serve for dipping.Coconut Grove prawn frittersCrisp fritters of chopped prawn, capsicum and spring onionHow to make it400g peeled green prawns, chopped150g self-raising flour1 egg150ml soda water1/2 red capsicum, diced2 spring onions, sliced1/2 tsp Cajun seasoning1 L vegetable oil, for frying100g mayonnaise2 tbsp sweet chilli sauce2 limes, juicedMix the flour, egg, soda water, capsicum, spring onions, Cajun seasoning and salt into a thick batter, then fold in the prawns.Drop heaped tablespoons into oil at 180°C and fry, turning, until golden. Drain.Mix the mayonnaise, sweet chilli sauce and lime juice for the sauce.Cuban black bean dip with plantain chipsMoses the dog gets none. Neither does Jinx.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsWall of Gaylord mojo roast porkCitrus garlic roast pork shoulder with black beans and fried bananaHow to make it8 garlic cloves2 oranges, juiced2 limes, juiced3 tsp ground cumin2 tsp dried oregano60ml olive oil1.5kg boneless pork shoulder1 onion, diced1 green capsicum, diced2 tins of black beans (400g each), drained300g long grain rice2 firm bananas, sliced20g butterBlitz the garlic, orange and lime juice, two teaspoons of the cumin, oregano, oil and salt. Rub over the pork.Marinate overnight in the fridge. This step is the day before.Roast covered at 160°C, then uncovered at 200°C.Fry the onion and capsicum, add the beans and remaining cumin and simmer.Cook the rice. Fry the banana slices in the butter.Rest and shred the pork and serve with beans, rice and bananas.Bernie's arroz con polloSaffron rice, chicken, peas and capsicum, one pot for the whole Focker clanHow to make it8 chicken thigh cutlets2 tbsp olive oil1 onion, diced1 red capsicum, diced3 garlic cloves, crushed1 pinch saffron threads1 tsp sweet paprika300g long grain rice700ml chicken stock150g frozen peas60g green olivesBrown the chicken skin side down in the oil until crisp. Lift out.Soften the onion, capsicum and garlic in the same pot, then stir in the saffron, paprika and rice.Pour in the stock, sit the chicken on top, cover and simmer on low until the rice is tender and the chicken cooked.Scatter over the peas and olives, cover and rest off the heat.SweetsJinx and Moses key lime pieTart lime custard in a biscuit crustHow to make it200g plain sweet biscuits80g butter, melted4 egg yolks395g tin condensed milk7 limes (150ml juice and zest)300ml thickened cream, whippedCrush the biscuits, mix with the butter and press into a 23cm pie dish.Bake the base at 180°C.Whisk the egg yolks with the condensed milk, then the lime juice and zest of two limes.Pour into the base and bake at 160°C until just set.Cool, then chill.Top with whipped cream and more lime zest.DrinksMiami mint mojitoWhite rum, mint, lime and soda. Roz says rum cures teethingHow to make it1 bunch mint3 limes3 tbsp caster sugar180ml white rum500ml soda water1 bag crushed iceIn each tall glass muddle mint leaves with lime wedges and sugar until the sugar dissolves.Fill with crushed ice and pour in the rum.Top with soda water and stir from the bottom with a long spoon. Garnish with a mint sprig and a lime wheel.Café con lecheLittle Jack's first word was Greg's fault.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
